name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Whisk flour, baking soda, and salt together in a bowl.
Beat butter and both sugars until light and fluffy, 3-4 minutes.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then vanilla.
Gradually mix in flour mixture until just combined.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto prepared baking sheets, 2 inches apart.
Bake 9-11 minutes until edges are golden but centers look slightly underdone.
Cool on baking sheet 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use vegan butter and dairy-free chocolate chips.
substitutions.vegan: Use vegan butter and replace each egg with 1 flax egg.

notes: Pull them out when they look slightly underbaked — they firm up as they cool.
